attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Custom biped controller orient fixes.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- FixArms: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- FixClavicles: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- FixPelvis: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- FixLegs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- FixToes: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- FixFingers: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- FixMisc: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
